summary: Held through repeated large whipsaws (a -20pt dip at t=2m and a -37pt retrace at t=7m) that both fully recovered back to strongly favorable levels (+30 to +50pts), so early dips alone were treated as noise, not reversal. Next time I'd watch for the amplitude-overshoot signature (giveback>100% of leg amp) earlier as the key discriminator between a normal pullback and an actual reversal, since raw px sign alone was noisy throughout this episode.
